crossRefs.note: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.
Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the…
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood?
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.
Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

translations.web: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
translations.bsb: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
translations.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
translations.asv: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
